purpose: Apply the canonical DLC/addon/content eligibility rules after the mandatory taste checkpoint using cached Steam content metadata, without using price, discount, reviews or SteamDB as taste evidence.

rules.sub_package: eligible_for_family_resolution only when at least one contained app or the feed representative app is taste-include in the same run; otherwise unresolved and fail closed
rules.dlc_without_same_run_taste_include_base: requires canonical-profile/current-user-context support for the base game or proof that the addon is effectively standalone game-like content; otherwise unresolved and fail closed

pass_requires: all 101 current taste includes are classified
all exclusions use canonical content eligibility reason codes
checkpoint proof is current and complete
